statement: For each n>=2 an isotropic log-concave uniform regular simplex on R^n has edge-parallel orthogonal one-dimensional conditional laws with ess sup conditional variance=(n+1)(n+2)/6, ess sup conditional Poincare constant=2(n+1)(n+2)/pi^2, and ess inf conditional Cheeger constant=sqrt(2/((n+1)(n+2))). Each near-extremal range has positive marginal probability. Mean conditional variance is exactly 1 and mean conditional Poincare constant is 12/pi^2.
assumptions: Euclidean metric; Poincare constant uses Var(f)<=C_P integral |f'|^2; Cheeger uses boundary/min(mass,1-mass).
Condition onto the orthogonal complement of one edge direction; use marginal-almost-everywhere disintegration.
proof_or_counterexample: Explicit vertices a(e_i-m), a^2=(n+1)(n+2); Dirichlet moments establish isotropy. Fiber length L S, L^2=2(n+1)(n+2), S~Beta(2,n-1). Uniform-interval constants and exact beta moments give all formulas.
